legend: You are given the coordinates $X$ and $Y$ of a point in the plane. Say where it lies:\begin{itemize}\item "Q1", "Q2", "Q3" or "Q4" for the quadrant it is in;\item "Origem" if it is the origin;\item "Eixo X" if it lies on the X axis (but is not the origin);\item "Eixo Y" if it lies on the Y axis (but is not the origin).\end{itemize}
input: One line with two real numbers $X$ and $Y$, each with one digit after the decimal point ($-1000 \le X, Y \le 1000$).
